title: What's a Bird Doing in the Spare Pot?

collection.credit: NEW EVENTS — WHAT'S THAT DOING HERE? (WD-01 to WD-50, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)

ledger.why: the casting line (the roles carry it)

collection.description: A villager tips over the old feast pot to clean it and finds a bird's nest with three tiny eggs underneath.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (name1) has a big cooking pot that (he/she) only uses for feasts. It's been sitting outside the hut, upside down, for weeks. Today (he/she) tips it over to clean it and finds a small bird has built a nest underneath, right inside, out of grass and feathers and one of (name1)'s old sandal straps. There are three tiny eggs in it.

choices.label: Tell Everyone to Leave It Alone

b.name: Answer B
b.text: (name1) tips the pot back and tells everyone in the village that the feast pot is out of use until further notice. "Why?" "There's a bird in it." People seem to accept this as a perfectly good reason. When the chicks finally fly, (name1) gets the pot back, with a lovely nest in it, which (he/she) decides to leave there for next year.

a__fx.name: Answer A
a__fx.text: (name1) gently tips the pot back over, exactly as it was. The bird, which has been hopping about anxiously nearby, darts back underneath. (name1) uses a different pot for the next feast. A few weeks later, (he/she) hears tiny cheeping from under the pot, and grins every time (he/she) walks past.
